why: Each step adds one new symbol on top of the stack and pushes the old ones down: arrow; cross over arrow; then a circle on top. D (square, circle, cross, arrow) confirms the order. So C is circle, cross, arrow in one column, which is option 5. Option 2 has the arrow and cross in the wrong order.
trick: When a new item appears each step, check where it is added (top) and keep the old order the same.
